post.description: Better Auth email/password sign-in. Requires application/json. Session is set via Set-Cookie; sign in first in this browser to reuse cookies on other Auth calls.
Terminate the session. Better Auth requires Content-Type application/json; send body {}. Requires the session cookie (sign in via POST /api/auth/sign-in/email in this browser first).

get.description: Better Auth exposes GET /get-session (not /session). Send the session cookie. Returns { session, user } or null when unauthenticated.

200.description: Session and user when authenticated; when logged out Better Auth may return null or an empty payload depending on version—see Better Auth get-session docs.

post.description: Send a password reset email. Requires application/json. Optional redirectTo should match your reset page path (e.g. with locale).

post.description: POST /reset-password under /api/auth. Requires application/json. Body must use newPassword and token (from reset email query string), not password.

400.description: Invalid or expired token / validation error

post.description: POST /change-password under /api/auth. Requires application/json and session cookie. Body uses currentPassword and newPassword (not oldPassword). Optional revokeOtherSessions invalidates other devices.

revokeOtherSessions.description: If true, sign out other sessions (default false if omitted)

400.description: Validation error or incorrect current password

post.description:
Authenticated endpoint. Conditionally upserts a token document at
`fcm_tokens/{userId}/tokens/{token}` (skip write when unchanged), syncs topic
subscriptions, and updates `updatedAt` for Firestore TTL when written.

200.description:
Registration result. `status` is `registered` (new doc), `updated`
(metadata or reactivation), or `already_registered` (no server write).

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Better Auth at `/api/auth/*`. POSTs expect **Content-Type: application/json** (use `{}` for sign-out). Email: `/sign-in/email`, `/sign-up/email`, `/request-password-reset`, `/reset-password`, `/change-password`. Session: **GET /get-session** (not `/session`). Uses **session** cookie.
